info.title: AI Code Reviewer API
info.description: Submit a code snippet and receive an AI-powered code review. The review is returned as a Markdown-formatted string covering bugs, performance, security, style, and best practices.

post.description: Submit a code snippet as a string and receive a structured Markdown review from an AI acting as a senior software engineer. The review covers: bug detection, performance, security vulnerabilities, code style, DRY/SOLID principles, refactoring tips, and documentation advice.

code.description: The source code string to be reviewed. Can be any programming language.
code.example: function sum(a, b) { return a + b }

schema.description: A structured code review in Markdown format.

400.description: Bad request — code field missing or empty

500.description: Internal server error — AI generation failed
